# Poteto bundle installation

Install `third_party/poteto/` as one bundle root. Keep its `LICENSE`, `provenance.json`, `_shared/`, and all three skill directories together so relative references and attribution remain intact.

Merge into the target harness's documented skill location; preserve local customisations and do not copy credentials, private transcripts, account-specific data, or machine paths. Run the collection checks before and after installation. The repository's maintainer export copies this guidance, the licence, and provenance beside each exported poteto skill.
